title: Latex Beads Migration Assay
author: Jorge Fernandez Mendez
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.8hwht7e

steps.title: Prepare Microfluidic Membranes
steps.instruction: Prepare two FF170HP strips and three FF80HP strips (1 cm wide x 4 cm long) and wax print them according to the guidelines protocol.

steps.title: Block Membranes
steps.instruction: Block one FF170HP and two FF80HP membranes using a 0.2% BSA solution in PBS.

substeps.instruction: Immerse membranes in 0.2% BSA solution in PBS
Dry membranes for 1h at room temperature
Store membranes in a desiccator at 4ºC overnight

steps.title: Deposit Latex Beads
steps.instruction: Apply 20 µL of conjugated latex beads stock to the sample deposition area of the sealed membranes.

substeps.instruction: Aspire 20 µL of conjugated latex beads stock
Pipette beads onto the sample deposition area
Place strips at a brief inclination (sample deposition region facing down) to prevent the sample from falling through the membrane surface

steps.title: Incubate and Visualize
steps.instruction: Allow the sample to migrate and the membranes to dry before handling.

substeps.instruction: Wait 15 minutes for the liquid in the sample to migrate completely
Wait until membranes are dry before manipulation
